meta.note: Which published plan the TCO calculator uses to represent each provider. Chosen by hand, not by taking the cheapest row: an automatic 'lowest price' pick selects AWS Glacier and Cloudflare R2 Infrequent Access, which are archive tiers and would make the comparison nonsense. Only offers priced per GB or per TB can be scaled linearly; flat bundles (DigitalOcean's $5 for 250 GiB, UpCloud's $5 per 250 GB) and per-seat plans are excluded rather than modelled with invented assumptions.
meta.linear_rule: month/gb x 1024, month/tb as-is, year/tb / 12. Everything else is out of scope.
